excerpt: # Release v5.23.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling2 Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters. It keeps the Inkling decoder (learned relative attention, short causal convolutions, mixture-of-experts layers) and adds block attention residuals, gated attention with a learned sink, and dynamic key/value convolutions. Images are encoded by a Perception Encoder-based vision transformer and projected into the language model embeddings, one embedding per 40x40 pixel patch. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/) * Add inkling2 (#50682) by @guarin in [#50682](https://github.com/huggingface/transforme
